ns2:section.sectionText: This section will be offered mostly online, with identical assessments from the online section, but with one in-person component. All lecture content will be delivered via pre-recorded videos, and all course assessments will be completed via PrairieLearn. The only difference from the online section is that students registered in this section will complete the group activities during the Tuesday lecture. ATTENDANCE IS REQUIRED. The other synchronous component are the bi-weekly quizzes scheduled on Thursdays during lecture time, delivered ONLINE via PrairieLearn (with Zoom proctoring). There will be an option of a conflict time for students with valid reason (for example, different timezones). You can find more detailed information here: https://courses.grainger.illinois.edu/cs357/ For up-to-date information about CS course restrictions, please see the following link: http://go.cs.illinois.edu/csregister
